items.why: 昨天还很热 sets up a contrast: it is cold now and was not before, so the sentence closes with 了. 着 and 过 do not mark a new state, and 呢 would only stress that it is still so.

items.q: 他的感冒好___，不用再吃药了。
items.zh: 他的感冒好了，不用再吃药了。
items.py: tā de gǎn mào hǎo le bù yòng zài chī yào le
items.en: His cold has cleared up; he does not need to take medicine any more.
items.why: 好了 reports a change (sick before, well now), and the next clause 不用再吃药 depends on it. 着 and 的 cannot mark a change, and 好过 would mean something like feeling better than before.

items.q: 快要下雪___，你出门别忘了戴帽子。
items.zh: 快要下雪了，你出门别忘了戴帽子。
items.py: kuài yào xià xuě le nǐ chū mén bié wàng le dài mào zi
items.en: It's about to snow, so don't forget your hat when you go out.
items.why: 快要 … 了 is the frame for something about to happen: 了 closes the clause. 过 or 着 cannot complete 快要, and 的 would turn the clause into a noun phrase.

items.q: 经过一个星期的治疗，他的咳嗽终于好___。
items.zh: 经过一个星期的治疗，他的咳嗽终于好了。
items.py: jīng guò yī ge xīng qī de zhì liáo tā de ké sou zhōng yú hǎo le
items.en: After a week of treatment, his cough has finally cleared up.
items.why: 终于 reports that a long-awaited change has happened, so the clause ends with 了. Without it the sentence stops short, 过 would mean it had cleared up earlier, and 着 cannot follow 好 here.

items.q: 树叶已经黄___，一阵风吹来就掉了。
items.zh: 树叶已经黄了，一阵风吹来就掉了。
items.py: shù yè yǐ jīng huáng le yī zhèn fēng chuī lái jiù diào le
items.en: The leaves have already turned yellow; one gust of wind and they fall.
items.why: 已经 plus an adjective reports a change that has taken place (green before, yellow now), so 了 comes at the end. 着 would say the leaves stay yellow, and 过 does not fit.

items.q: 雨停___，我们出去走走吧。
items.zh: 雨停了，我们出去走走吧。
items.py: yǔ tíng le wǒ men chū qù zǒu zou ba
items.en: The rain has stopped; let's go out for a walk.
items.why: The rain was falling and now is not, so the clause ends with 了. 着 and 的 cannot mark the stopping, and 停过 would say it had stopped at some earlier time.

items.q: 天越来越冷，医院里感冒的病人也多___。
items.zh: 天越来越冷，医院里感冒的病人也多了。
items.py: tiān yuè lái yuè lěng yī yuàn lǐ gǎn mào de bìng rén yě duō le
items.en: It's getting colder and colder, and there are more patients with colds in the hospital too.
items.why: 越来越 describes a change under way, so the result 多 ends with 了: there are more patients than before. Bare 多 would only describe, 过 and 着 do not mark a change, and 的 cannot close the clause.

items.q: 孩子的烧退___，现在不烫了。
items.zh: 孩子的烧退了，现在不烫了。
items.py: hái zi de shāo tuì le xiàn zài bù tàng le
items.en: The child's fever has gone down; he isn't hot to the touch any more.
items.why: The fever was high and has now dropped, so 退 takes final 了. 着, 的 and 地 cannot mark a completed change of state.

items.q: 这场雨都下了三天___，还是没有停的意思。
items.zh: 这场雨都下了三天了，还是没有停的意思。
items.py: zhè chǎng yǔ dōu xià le sān tiān le hái shi méi yǒu tíng de yì si
items.en: It has been raining for three whole days and shows no sign of stopping.
items.why: 都 and 还是没有停 say the rain is still going, so the amount "so far" takes a second 了 at the end. 过 and 着 cannot close it.

items.q: 他已经发烧了三天___，一直没退，今天一定得去医院。
items.zh: 他已经发烧了三天了，一直没退，今天一定得去医院。
items.py: tā yǐ jīng fā shāo le sān tiān le yī zhí méi tuì jīn tiān yī dìng děi qù yī yuàn
items.en: He has already had a fever for three days and it has not gone down; he has to go to the hospital today.
items.why: The fever has lasted three days and is still there: 了 after the verb and 了 again at the end (已经 … 了). 过 or 着 would not give the "so far" reading.

items.q: 去年冬天我感冒了两个星期___，后来才好。
items.zh: 去年冬天我感冒了两个星期，后来才好。
items.py: qù nián dōng tiān wǒ gǎn mào le liǎng ge xīng qī hòu lái cái hǎo
items.en: Last winter I had a cold for two weeks before I got better.
items.why: 去年冬天 and 后来才好 close the period: the two weeks are over, so only the verb 了 is used. A final 了 would say the cold is still going on, which clashes with 后来才好.

items.q: 他在医院里住___半个月___，上个星期才回家。
items.zh: 他在医院里住了半个月，上个星期才回家。
items.py: tā zài yī yuàn lǐ zhù le bàn ge yuè shàng ge xīng qī cái huí jiā
items.en: He spent half a month in hospital and only came home last week.
items.why: 上个星期才回家 shows the stay is over, so the amount takes only the 了 after the verb. A second 了 would mean he is still in hospital, and dropping the first 了 leaves the finished stay unmarked.

items.q: 到现在他已经跑了五公里___，还不想停下来。
items.zh: 到现在他已经跑了五公里了，还不想停下来。
items.py: dào xiàn zài tā yǐ jīng pǎo le wǔ gōng lǐ le hái bù xiǎng tíng xià lái
items.en: By now he has already run five kilometres and still does not want to stop.
items.why: 到现在 and 还不想停 mean the running is still going, so the amount so far takes a second 了 at the end. 过, 着 and 的 cannot close the clause in this reading.

items.q: 小时候我在乡下住___十年___，所以特别喜欢那里的空气。
items.zh: 小时候我在乡下住了十年，所以特别喜欢那里的空气。
items.py: xiǎo shí hou wǒ zài xiāng xià zhù le shí nián suǒ yǐ tè bié xǐ huan nà lǐ de kōng qì
items.en: I lived in the countryside for ten years as a child, so I especially like the air there.
items.why: 小时候 closes the period: the ten years are over, so only the verb 了 is used. A second 了 would say he is still living there, and with no 了 at all the finished stay is not marked.

items.q: 这个冬天已经下了五场雪___，路上的雪还没化完。
items.zh: 这个冬天已经下了五场雪了，路上的雪还没化完。
items.py: zhè ge dōng tiān yǐ jīng xià le wǔ chǎng xuě le lù shàng de xuě hái méi huà wán
items.en: This winter it has already snowed five times, and the snow on the road has not all melted yet.
items.why: This winter is still going on, so the count is "so far": 了 after 下 and 了 again at the end (已经 … 了). 过 or 着 would not give a running total.

items.q: 他昨晚吃___两片药就睡了。
items.zh: 他昨晚吃了两片药就睡了。
items.py: tā zuó wǎn chī le liǎng piàn yào jiù shuì le
items.en: Last night he took two tablets and went to sleep.
items.why: In "after A, then B" with a counted object, 了 goes right after the first verb. 着 would mean he was taking pills while going to bed, and 的 or 地 cannot mark the completed first step.

items.q: 小王昨天吃___那两片退烧药就躺下了。
items.zh: 小王昨天吃了那两片退烧药就躺下了。
items.py: xiǎo wáng zuó tiān chī le nà liǎng piàn tuì shāo yào jiù tǎng xià le
items.en: Xiao Wang took those two fever tablets yesterday and lay down.
items.why: The first step is finished before the next one starts, so 了 follows 吃 and precedes the specific object. 着 would turn it into an action still in progress while lying down.

items.q: 我洗___三次手，才开始吃饭。
items.zh: 我洗了三次手，才开始吃饭。
items.py: wǒ xǐ le sān cì shǒu cái kāi shǐ chī fàn
items.en: I washed my hands three times before I started eating.
items.why: Hand-washing is a bounded, finished action (三次) that comes before eating, so 了 goes after 洗. 着 would mean washing while eating, which does not fit 才开始吃饭.

items.q: 你喝___这两杯热水，再休息一会儿吧。
items.zh: 你喝了这两杯热水，再休息一会儿吧。
items.py: nǐ hē le zhè liǎng bēi rè shuǐ zài xiū xi yī huì r ba
items.en: Drink these two cups of hot water first, then rest for a while.
items.why: In "do A, then B" even for a future request, 了 goes right after the first verb to mean once A is done. 着 would mean resting while drinking, and 的 or 地 mark nothing here.

items.q: 吃___饭，我们去公园散步。
items.zh: 吃了饭，我们去公园散步。
items.py: chī le fàn wǒ men qù gōng yuán sàn bù
items.en: After we eat, let's go for a walk in the park.
items.why: "Once A is done, B": 了 goes straight after the first verb, 吃. 着 would mean walking while eating, and 的 or 地 cannot appear after the verb here.

items.q: 你先量___体温，再决定要不要吃药。
items.zh: 你先量了体温，再决定要不要吃药。
items.py: nǐ xiān liáng le tǐ wēn zài jué dìng yào bù yào chī yào
items.en: Take your temperature first, then decide whether to take medicine.
items.why: 先 … 再 describes two steps in order, and 了 after the first verb says that step must be done before the second begins. 着 would mean doing both at once.

items.q: 等天气暖和___，我们就带孩子去公园放风筝。
items.zh: 等天气暖和了，我们就带孩子去公园放风筝。
items.py: děng tiān qì nuǎn huo le wǒ men jiù dài hái zi qù gōng yuán fàng fēng zheng
items.en: Once the weather warms up, we will take the children to the park to fly kites.
items.why: 等 … 了 … 就 means once the change has happened, even though it is in the future. 着 and 的 cannot mark that change, and 过 would put it in the past.

items.q: 我昨晚喝___那碗姜汤，出___一身汗，今天早上感觉好多了。
items.zh: 我昨晚喝了那碗姜汤，出了一身汗，今天早上感觉好多了。
items.py: wǒ zuó wǎn hē le nà wǎn jiāng tāng chū le yī shēn hàn jīn tiān zǎo shang gǎn jué hǎo duō le
items.en: Last night I drank that bowl of ginger soup and broke into a sweat; this morning I feel much better.
items.why: Both steps are finished events: 喝了那碗姜汤 and 出了一身汗. 着 would mean the drinking was still going on, and a 着 after 出 would not give a finished sweat.

items.q: 我每天早上喝___一杯热水。
items.zh: 我每天早上喝一杯热水。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang hē yī bēi rè shuǐ
items.en: I drink a cup of hot water every morning.
items.why: 每天 makes this a routine, not one finished event, so 了 is left out even though 一杯 is a counted object. 了 would turn it into a single completed drinking.

items.q: 小时候妈妈经常给我煮___姜汤。
items.zh: 小时候妈妈经常给我煮姜汤。
items.py: xiǎo shí hou mā ma jīng cháng gěi wǒ zhǔ jiāng tāng
items.en: When I was little, my mum often made me ginger soup.
items.why: 经常 marks a repeated habit, and a habit in the past still takes no 了. English past tense tempts you to add it, but 小时候 already puts it in the past.

items.q: 夏天他常常喝___冰水，所以总是拉肚子。
items.zh: 夏天他常常喝冰水，所以总是拉肚子。
items.py: xià tiān tā cháng cháng hē bīng shuǐ suǒ yǐ zǒng shì lā dù zi
items.en: In summer he often drinks iced water, so he often has an upset stomach.
items.why: 常常 and 总是 describe a repeated pattern, so the verb stays bare. 了 would turn it into one completed drinking, which contradicts the habit.

items.q: 那几年每到秋天，奶奶都要腌___很多萝卜，一直吃到春天。
items.zh: 那几年每到秋天，奶奶都要腌很多萝卜，一直吃到春天。
items.py: nà jǐ nián měi dào qiū tiān nǎi nai dōu yào yān hěn duō luó bo yī zhí chī dào chūn tiān
items.en: In those years, every autumn Grandma would pickle lots of radishes, and we ate them until spring.
items.why: 每到秋天 and 都要 describe a yearly routine, so no 了 even though the object is quantified (很多萝卜). 了 would make it one completed pickling.

items.q: 我们一般晚上八点吃___药。
items.zh: 我们一般晚上八点吃药。
items.py: wǒ men yī bān wǎn shang bā diǎn chī yào
items.en: We usually take our medicine at eight in the evening.
items.why: 一般 marks a regular habit, so the verb takes no 了. 了 would report one completed event, and 过 would mean having taken it at some earlier time.

items.q: 我昨天没吃___早饭。
items.zh: 我昨天没吃早饭。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān méi chī zǎo fàn
items.en: I didn't have breakfast yesterday.
items.why: 没 already says the action did not happen, so there is nothing left for 了 to mark. 没吃了 is never right for "did not eat", and 没吃过 would mean never having eaten.

items.q: 医生让我吃药，可是我没吃___那些药。
items.zh: 医生让我吃药，可是我没吃那些药。
items.py: yī shēng ràng wǒ chī yào kě shì wǒ méi chī nà xiē yào
items.en: The doctor told me to take medicine, but I didn't take those pills.
items.why: A negated past action is 没 + verb, with no 了 after it. 没吃了 cannot mean "did not eat"; 着 and 的 do not belong here at all.

items.q: 昨天一整天都没下___雨，天气特别好。
items.zh: 昨天一整天都没下雨，天气特别好。
items.py: zuó tiān yī zhěng tiān dōu méi xià yǔ tiān qì tè bié hǎo
items.en: It did not rain all day yesterday, and the weather was great.
items.why: 没下雨 reports that rain did not occur, and 没 rules out 了. 没下了雨 is never right as "did not rain", and 着 or 的 do not fit.

items.q: 虽然医生让他多休息，但是他昨天一点儿也没休息___。
items.zh: 虽然医生让他多休息，但是他昨天一点儿也没休息。
items.py: suī rán yī shēng ràng tā duō xiū xi dàn shì tā zuó tiān yī diǎn r yě méi xiū xi
items.en: Although the doctor told him to rest more, he did not rest at all yesterday.
items.why: 一点儿也没 is a strong negative of a past action, and with 没 there is no 了 anywhere in the clause. 了 would contradict the denial that the resting happened.

items.q: 感冒的时候他没去___学校，一直在家休息。
items.zh: 感冒的时候他没去学校，一直在家休息。
items.py: gǎn mào de shí hou tā méi qù xué xiào yī zhí zài jiā xiū xi
items.en: When he had a cold he did not go to school and stayed home to rest.
items.why: 没去 says he did not go, so 了 must be dropped. 去了 would say he went, which is the opposite of the sentence.

items.q: 去年冬天北京很冷___，我每天都穿羽绒服。
items.zh: 去年冬天北京很冷，我每天都穿羽绒服。
items.py: qù nián dōng tiān běi jīng hěn lěng wǒ měi tiān dōu chuān yǔ róng fú
items.en: Last winter Beijing was very cold, and I wore a down jacket every day.
items.why: This describes how things were, not a change, and 去年冬天 already shows it is past. 很冷了 would announce that it has newly turned cold, which is not the point.

items.q: 我小时候很怕___打针，每次都哭。
items.zh: 我小时候很怕打针，每次都哭。
items.py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou hěn pà dǎ zhēn měi cì dōu kū
items.en: When I was little I was very afraid of injections and cried every time.
items.why: 怕 is a state, and 小时候 with 每次都 shows a past habit of feeling, so no 了. Adding 了 after 怕 would suggest a sudden event rather than a lasting feeling.

items.q: 医生昨天觉得___我的病不严重，让我回家休息。
items.zh: 医生昨天觉得我的病不严重，让我回家休息。
items.py: yī shēng zuó tiān jué de wǒ de bìng bù yán zhòng ràng wǒ huí jiā xiū xi
items.en: The doctor thought my illness wasn't serious and sent me home to rest.
items.why: 觉得 is a thought state; the past comes from 昨天, and 觉得了 is never used to mean "thought". 了 only fits a new realisation at the end of a clause, not directly after 觉得.

items.q: 昨天下午公园里有___很多人，大家都在晒太阳。
items.zh: 昨天下午公园里有很多人，大家都在晒太阳。
items.py: zuó tiān xià wǔ gōng yuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō rén dà jiā dōu zài shài tài yáng
items.en: There were lots of people in the park yesterday afternoon, all sunning themselves.
items.why: 有 describes what existed, which is a state, so it takes no 了; 昨天下午 shows the past. 过 would mean "have been" in some earlier time, and 着 does not belong here.

items.q: 他以前是___我们学校最好的游泳运动员，现在腿受伤了。
items.zh: 他以前是我们学校最好的游泳运动员，现在腿受伤了。
items.py: tā yǐ qián shì wǒ men xué xiào zuì hǎo de yóu yǒng yùn dòng yuán xiàn zài tuǐ shòu shāng le
items.en: He used to be the best swimmer at our school, but now his leg is injured.
items.why: 是 is never followed by 了 to mean "was"; 以前 carries the past. The final 了 in 受伤了 is a separate, correct change-of-state 了.

items.q: 我那时候很喜欢___夏天，因为可以天天游泳。
items.zh: 我那时候很喜欢夏天，因为可以天天游泳。
items.py: wǒ nà shí hou hěn xǐ huan xià tiān yīn wèi kě yǐ tiān tiān yóu yǒng
items.en: Back then I really liked summer, because I could swim every day.
items.why: 喜欢 is a feeling, and 那时候 supplies the past, so no 了. 喜欢了 would suggest I had just come to like it.

items.q: 今天太热___，我们别出去了。
items.zh: 今天太热了，我们别出去了。
items.py: jīn tiān tài rè le wǒ men bié chū qù le
items.en: It's too hot today; let's not go out.
items.why: A remark with 太 + adjective closes with 了: 太热了. 的, 着 and 过 cannot finish a 太 remark.

items.q: 这种药太苦___，孩子不愿意吃。
items.zh: 这种药太苦了，孩子不愿意吃。
items.py: zhè zhǒng yào tài kǔ le hái zi bù yuàn yì chī
items.en: This medicine is too bitter; the child won't take it.
items.why: 太 + adjective at the end of a clause takes 了: 太苦了. Without 了 the remark sounds cut off, and 的, 着 or 过 are not used after the adjective.

items.q: 太冷___的天气我不想出门。
items.zh: 太冷的天气我不想出门。
items.py: tài lěng de tiān qì wǒ bù xiǎng chū mén
items.en: I don't want to go out in weather that is too cold.
items.why: Here 太冷 is only a modifier inside a longer noun phrase (太冷的天气), so it takes no 了; 了 belongs to 太 remarks that end the clause. 太冷了的天气 is not a Chinese phrase.

items.q: 医生说你的身体太弱___，必须多休息。
items.zh: 医生说你的身体太弱了，必须多休息。
items.py: yī shēng shuō nǐ de shēn tǐ tài ruò le bì xū duō xiū xi
items.en: The doctor says your body is too weak and you must rest more.
items.why: A complete remark with 太 + adjective ends with 了: 太弱了. 的, 着 and 过 cannot close it, and without any particle the remark sounds incomplete.

items.q: 我头不疼___，可以去上课了。
items.zh: 我头不疼了，可以去上课了。
items.py: wǒ tóu bù téng le kě yǐ qù shàng kè le
items.en: My head does not hurt any more; I can go to class now.
items.why: "No longer" is 不 + verb + 了: it hurt before, and now it does not. 过, 着 and 地 cannot mark that change.

items.q: 雨太大了，我们不去爬山___。
items.zh: 雨太大了，我们不去爬山了。
items.py: yǔ tài dà le wǒ men bù qù pá shān le
items.en: The rain is too heavy; we're not going hiking after all.
items.why: A changed plan is 不 + verb + 了: we meant to go and now are not going. 过, 着 and 地 cannot express "after all".

items.q: 他已经戒烟了，现在不抽烟___。
items.zh: 他已经戒烟了，现在不抽烟了。
items.py: tā yǐ jīng jiè yān le xiàn zài bù chōu yān le
items.en: He has quit smoking and doesn't smoke any more.
items.why: 已经 and 现在 say the situation has changed, so 不抽烟 takes 了 at the end: he did smoke before, and does not now. 过, 着 and 地 cannot mark "any more".

items.q: 退烧药都吃完了，家里没有药___。
items.zh: 退烧药都吃完了，家里没有药了。
items.py: tuì shāo yào dōu chī wán le jiā lǐ méi yǒu yào le
items.en: The fever medicine is all gone; there is no medicine left in the house.
items.why: 没有 + noun + 了 means "none left": there was some, now there is not. 过, 着 and 地 do not mark that change.

items.q: 天太冷了，爷爷说他今天不想出门___。
items.zh: 天太冷了，爷爷说他今天不想出门了。
items.py: tiān tài lěng le yé ye shuō tā jīn tiān bù xiǎng chū mén le
items.en: It's so cold that Grandpa says he doesn't want to go out today after all.
items.why: The cold has changed his mind: 不想出门 + 了 means he no longer wants to go. 过, 着 and 地 cannot express a change of plan.

items.zh: 我昨天喝了三杯热水。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān hē le sān bēi rè shuǐ
items.en: I drank three cups of hot water yesterday.
items.why: 了 goes right after 喝, before the counted object 三杯热水. The time word 昨天 can come before or after the subject.

items.zh: 今天天气暖和了。
items.py: jīn tiān tiān qì nuǎn huo le
items.en: The weather has warmed up today.
items.why: The change of state is closed by 了 at the very end. 了 cannot sit before 暖和, and the time word may come before or after 天气.

items.zh: 下个月天气就要变冷了。
items.py: xià ge yuè tiān qì jiù yào biàn lěng le
items.en: The weather will turn cold next month.
items.why: 就要 … 了 frames something about to happen, so 了 must end the sentence. 下个月 may come before or after 天气.

items.zh: 我咳嗽了一个星期了。
items.py: wǒ ké sou le yī ge xīng qī le
items.en: I have been coughing for a week now.
items.why: For "so far, and still going" the first 了 follows the verb and the second closes the sentence. The duration 一个星期 sits between them.

items.zh: 这里已经下了一个星期的雨了。
items.py: zhè lǐ yǐ jīng xià le yī ge xīng qī de yǔ le
items.en: It has already been raining here for a week.
items.why: 已经 plus a duration that is still running needs 了 after the verb and 了 at the end. 这里 may come before or after 已经.

items.zh: 我吃了两片药就睡觉。
items.py: wǒ chī le liǎng piàn yào jiù shuì jiào
items.en: I'll go to sleep once I've taken two tablets.
items.why: In "after A, then B", 了 goes right after the first verb 吃, before the counted object 两片药, and 就 introduces the second step.

items.zh: 他昨天洗了热水澡就睡了。
items.py: tā zuó tiān xǐ le rè shuǐ zǎo jiù shuì le
items.en: Yesterday he took a hot bath and went straight to bed.
items.why: The first step takes 了 right after the verb, and a past sequence is closed by a second 了 at the end. 昨天 may come before or after 他.

items.zh: 你量了体温再决定吃不吃药。
items.py: nǐ liáng le tǐ wēn zài jué dìng chī bù chī yào
items.en: Take your temperature first, then decide whether to take medicine.
items.why: 再 means only after the first step is done, so the first verb 量 carries 了 before its object 体温. 了 cannot move to the end.

items.zh: 我现在不吃甜的了。
items.py: wǒ xiàn zài bù chī tián de le
items.en: I don't eat sweet things any more.
items.why: "Not any more" is 不 + verb + object + 了, with 了 last. 现在 may come before or after 我.

items.zh: 因为下雨，他不来了。
items.py: yīn wèi xià yǔ tā bù lái le
items.en: Because it's raining, he isn't coming after all.
items.why: The changed plan 不来 takes 了 at the end. The subject 他 may stand before or after the reason clause 因为下雨, but 了 stays last.

items.zh: 我昨天没吃退烧药。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān méi chī tuì shāo yào
items.en: I didn't take any fever medicine yesterday.
items.why: 没 goes before the verb and no 了 appears, so the spare tile 了 is not used. 昨天 may come before or after 我.

items.zh: 去年冬天北京很冷。
items.py: qù nián dōng tiān běi jīng hěn lěng
items.en: Beijing was very cold last winter.
items.why: A past state is described with 很 + adjective and no 了; the time phrase already shows it is past. The spare tile 了 is not used.

items.zh: 我每天晚上都喝一杯牛奶。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān wǎn shang dōu hē yī bēi niú nǎi
items.en: I drink a glass of milk every evening.
items.why: 每天晚上 marks a routine, so the verb takes no 了 even with the counted object 一杯. The spare tile 了 is not used.

items.zh: 我们等了半个小时了，医生还没来。
items.py: wǒ men děng le bàn ge xiǎo shí le yī shēng hái méi lái
items.en: We have been waiting for half an hour and the doctor still hasn't come.
items.why: The wait is still going, so the amount takes 了 after the verb and 了 at the end of its clause. The two clauses can swap places.

items.src_py: wǒ zuó tiān qù yī yuàn le
items.task: Make it negative.
items.zh: 我昨天没去医院。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān méi qù yī yuàn
items.en: I didn't go to the hospital yesterday.
items.why: To say it did not happen, use 没 + verb and drop 了. 不去了 would mean a changed plan instead.

items.src_py: tā hē le nà bēi jiāng tāng
items.task: Make it negative.
items.zh: 他没喝那杯姜汤。
items.py: tā méi hē nà bēi jiāng tāng
items.en: He didn't drink that cup of ginger soup.
items.why: Negate a finished action with 没 and delete 了. 他没喝了那杯姜汤 is wrong.

items.src_py: tā měi tiān hē bīng shuǐ
items.task: Say he doesn't drink it any more.
items.zh: 他不喝冰水了。
items.py: tā bù hē bīng shuǐ le
items.en: He doesn't drink iced water any more.
items.why: "Not any more" is 不 + verb + object + 了. 没喝 would only say he did not drink on some occasion.

items.src: 下雨了，我们明天去爬山。
items.src_py: xià yǔ le wǒ men míng tiān qù pá shān
items.task: Say we are not going hiking any more.
items.zh: 下雨了，我们不去爬山了。
items.py: xià yǔ le wǒ men bù qù pá shān le
items.en: It's raining, so we're not going hiking any more.
items.why: A cancelled plan is 不 + verb + 了, with 了 at the end. 没去 would report a past fact, not a changed decision.

items.src_py: tiān qì hěn rè
items.task: Say the weather has turned hot (a change).
items.zh: 天气热了。
items.py: tiān qì rè le
items.en: The weather has turned hot.
items.why: To report a change, drop 很 and close with 了: 热了. 很热 is only a plain description.

items.src_py: tā xǐ rè shuǐ zǎo rán hòu shuì jiào
items.task: Join with 就: once he has bathed, he goes to bed.
items.zh: 他洗了热水澡就睡觉。
items.py: tā xǐ le rè shuǐ zǎo jiù shuì jiào
items.en: He goes to bed as soon as he has had a hot bath.
items.why: The first step takes 了 right after 洗, and 就 introduces the second. Both 了 positions are heard, but 了 must come before 就.

items.src_py: yǔ tíng yǐ hòu wǒ men qù pá shān
items.task: Use 了 and 就 for 'once the rain has stopped'.
items.zh: 雨停了，我们就去爬山。
items.py: yǔ tíng le wǒ men jiù qù pá shān
items.en: Once the rain stops, we will go hiking.
items.why: "Once A is done, B": 了 after the first verb and 就 before the second. 以后 is replaced by 了 + 就.

items.src: 他在医院里住了一个月。
items.src_py: tā zài yī yuàn lǐ zhù le yī ge yuè
items.task: Say he has been in hospital for a month so far and is still there.
items.zh: 他在医院里已经住了一个月了。
items.py: tā zài yī yuàn lǐ yǐ jīng zhù le yī ge yuè le
items.en: He has already been in hospital for a month.
items.why: For "so far, and still going" add a second 了 at the end after the amount. The single-了 source is a finished stay.

items.src_py: tā jīn tiān zǎo shang hē shuǐ
items.task: Say she drank two glasses of water this morning (finished).
items.zh: 她今天早上喝了两杯水。
items.py: tā jīn tiān zǎo shang hē le liǎng bēi shuǐ
items.en: She drank two glasses of water this morning.
items.why: A finished act with a counted object puts 了 right after 喝, before 两杯. The time phrase may come before or after 她.

items.src_py: zhè jiàn yǔ róng fú hěn guì
items.task: Say it is too expensive!
items.zh: 这件羽绒服太贵了！
items.py: zhè jiàn yǔ róng fú tài guì le
items.en: This down jacket is too expensive!
items.why: A 太 remark ends with 了: 太贵了. 很 does not take 了 in this way.

items.s: 昨天很热了，我们都没出门。
items.s_py: zuó tiān hěn rè le wǒ men dōu méi chū mén
items.zh: 昨天很热，我们都没出门。
items.py: zuó tiān hěn rè wǒ men dōu méi chū mén
items.en: It was very hot yesterday, so none of us went out.
items.why: A past description with 很 + adjective takes no 了; 昨天 already shows it is past. 很热了 would announce a change that is not meant here.

items.s: 小时候我每天都喝了牛奶。
items.s_py: xiǎo shí hou wǒ měi tiān dōu hē le niú nǎi
items.zh: 小时候我每天都喝牛奶。
items.py: xiǎo shí hou wǒ měi tiān dōu hē niú nǎi
items.en: When I was little I drank milk every day.
items.why: 每天都 makes this a habit, and a habit takes no 了 even in the past. 了 would present it as one finished drinking.

items.s: 这碗汤太了烫，我喝不了。
items.s_py: zhè wǎn tāng tài le tàng wǒ hē bù liǎo
items.zh: 这碗汤太烫了，我喝不了。
items.py: zhè wǎn tāng tài tàng le wǒ hē bù liǎo
items.en: This soup is too hot; I can't drink it.
items.why: In a 太 remark 了 closes the clause after the adjective: 太烫了. It cannot be inserted between 太 and 烫.

items.s: 太冷了，我们不去了公园。
items.s_py: tài lěng le wǒ men bù qù le gōng yuán
items.zh: 太冷了，我们不去公园了。
items.py: tài lěng le wǒ men bù qù gōng yuán le
items.en: It's too cold; we're not going to the park after all.
items.why: In 不 … 了 for a changed plan, 了 goes at the end of the clause, not right after the verb: 不去公园了. 不去了公园 is not Chinese.

items.s: 他以前是了我们的校医。
items.s_py: tā yǐ qián shì le wǒ men de xiào yī
items.zh: 他以前是我们的校医。
items.py: tā yǐ qián shì wǒ men de xiào yī
items.en: He used to be our school doctor.
items.why: 是 is a state, so it never takes 了 to mean "was"; 以前 already carries the past.

items.s: 我昨天买三件羽绒服。
items.s_py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi sān jiàn yǔ róng fú
items.zh: 我昨天买了三件羽绒服。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi le sān jiàn yǔ róng fú
items.en: I bought three down jackets yesterday.
items.why: One finished purchase with a counted object needs 了 right after the verb. 昨天 gives the time but cannot replace 了.

items.s: 医生说他还没好了，需要再住几天院。
items.s_py: yī shēng shuō tā hái méi hǎo le xū yào zài zhù jǐ tiān yuàn
items.zh: 医生说他还没好，需要再住几天院。
items.py: yī shēng shuō tā hái méi hǎo xū yào zài zhù jǐ tiān yuàn
items.en: The doctor says he isn't better yet and needs to stay in hospital a few more days.
items.why: 还没 says something has not happened yet, so it cannot be closed with 了, which would claim a change. The sentence needs the bare 还没好.

items.s: 我觉得了那个医生很年轻。
items.s_py: wǒ jué de le nà ge yī shēng hěn nián qīng
items.zh: 我觉得那个医生很年轻。
items.py: wǒ jué de nà ge yī shēng hěn nián qīng
items.en: I think that doctor is very young.
items.why: 觉得 is a mental state, and 了 cannot follow it. 我觉得了 is not a Chinese way to say "I thought".

items.s: 以前我常常迟到了。
items.s_py: yǐ qián wǒ cháng cháng chí dào le
items.zh: 以前我常常迟到。
items.py: yǐ qián wǒ cháng cháng chí dào
items.en: I used to be late often.
items.why: 常常 marks a repeated habit, so no 了, even though 以前 is in the past. A final 了 would present it as a new development.

items.s: 我三天没睡好觉了，头特别疼。
items.s_py: wǒ sān tiān méi shuì hǎo jiào le tóu tè bié téng
items.zh: 我三天没睡好觉了，头特别疼。
items.py: wǒ sān tiān méi shuì hǎo jiào le tóu tè bié téng
items.en: I haven't slept properly for three days and my head aches badly.
items.why: This is correct: duration + 没 + verb + 了 is a fixed pattern for "has not ... for three days (up to now)". The 了 here marks the ongoing situation, not a completed action.

items.s: 昨天下了一天的雨，路上全是水。
items.s_py: zuó tiān xià le yī tiān de yǔ lù shàng quán shì shuǐ
items.zh: 昨天下了一天的雨，路上全是水。
items.py: zuó tiān xià le yī tiān de yǔ lù shàng quán shì shuǐ
items.en: It rained all day yesterday and the road is full of water.
items.why: This is correct: a finished event with a counted duration (一天) takes 了 right after the verb. 是 in the second clause is a plain description with no 了.

items.s: 我没有退烧药了，你有吗？
items.s_py: wǒ méi yǒu tuì shāo yào le nǐ yǒu ma
items.zh: 我没有退烧药了，你有吗？
items.py: wǒ méi yǒu tuì shāo yào le nǐ yǒu ma
items.en: I've run out of fever medicine; do you have any?
items.why: This is correct: 没有 + noun + 了 means "none left", a legitimate 没 … 了 pattern, unlike a negated finished action.

items.s: 我以前很怕冷，现在不怕了。
items.s_py: wǒ yǐ qián hěn pà lěng xiàn zài bù pà le
items.zh: 我以前很怕冷，现在不怕了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ qián hěn pà lěng xiàn zài bù pà le
items.en: I used to be very afraid of the cold; I'm not any more.
items.why: This is correct: the past state 很怕冷 takes no 了, while the new situation 不怕 takes 了 at the end.

items.s: 去年夏天这里特别热，我们天天都开着空调。
items.s_py: qù nián xià tiān zhè lǐ tè bié rè wǒ men tiān tiān dōu kāi zhe kōng tiáo
items.zh: 去年夏天这里特别热，我们天天都开着空调。
items.py: qù nián xià tiān zhè lǐ tè bié rè wǒ men tiān tiān dōu kāi zhe kōng tiáo
items.en: Last summer it was very hot here and we kept the air conditioning on every day.
items.why: This is correct: the hot weather is a past state and the routine is a habit, so neither takes 了. 着 shows the air conditioning stayed on.

items.s: 他每天早上起床以后先量体温。
items.s_py: tā měi tiān zǎo shang qǐ chuáng yǐ hòu xiān liáng tǐ wēn
items.zh: 他每天早上起床以后先量体温。
items.py: tā měi tiān zǎo shang qǐ chuáng yǐ hòu xiān liáng tǐ wēn
items.en: Every morning after getting up, he takes his temperature first.
items.why: This is correct: 以后 does not call for 了, because this is a daily routine and 每天 rules out 了 on either verb.

items.s: 秋天了，树叶都黄了。
items.s_py: qiū tiān le shù yè dōu huáng le
items.zh: 秋天了，树叶都黄了。
items.py: qiū tiān le shù yè dōu huáng le
items.en: It's autumn now, and the leaves have all turned yellow.
items.why: This is correct: 秋天了 reports that the season has changed, and 黄了 reports a change in the leaves. Both 了 mark new situations.

items.s: 你下了课就来我家吧，我给你煮姜汤。
items.s_py: nǐ xià le kè jiù lái wǒ jiā ba wǒ gěi nǐ zhǔ jiāng tāng
items.zh: 你下了课就来我家吧，我给你煮姜汤。
items.py: nǐ xià le kè jiù lái wǒ jiā ba wǒ gěi nǐ zhǔ jiāng tāng
items.en: Come to my place as soon as class is over, and I'll make you ginger soup.
items.why: This is correct: in "once A is done, B" 了 goes after the first verb even for a future request. 煮姜汤 is a plain future action with no 了.

items.s: 今天不太冷，你不用穿那么厚。
items.s_py: jīn tiān bù tài lěng nǐ bù yòng chuān nà me hòu
items.zh: 今天不太冷，你不用穿那么厚。
items.py: jīn tiān bù tài lěng nǐ bù yòng chuān nà me hòu
items.en: It's not very cold today; you don't need to wear so much.
items.why: This is correct: 不太 + adjective is a plain description and takes no 了; only 太 + adjective as a remark ends in 了.

items.s: 我都咳嗽了两个星期了，今天一定要去医院。
items.s_py: wǒ dōu ké sou le liǎng ge xīng qī le jīn tiān yī dìng yào qù yī yuàn
items.zh: 我都咳嗽了两个星期了，今天一定要去医院。
items.py: wǒ dōu ké sou le liǎng ge xīng qī le jīn tiān yī dìng yào qù yī yuàn
items.en: I've been coughing for two whole weeks; I'm definitely going to the hospital today.
items.why: This is correct: the cough is still going, so the amount so far takes two 了, one after the verb and one at the end, as 都 … 了 expects.

items.q: 你到___地铁站，先给我打个电话，我再去接你。
items.zh: 你到了地铁站，先给我打个电话，我再去接你。
items.py: nǐ dào le dì tiě zhàn xiān gěi wǒ dǎ ge diàn huà wǒ zài qù jiē nǐ
items.en: Once you get to the subway station, call me first and then I'll come to meet you.
items.why: 到了 + place sets up 'once you've arrived' before the next steps (先…再…), so 了 follows 到. 过 means you have been there before, and 着 does not fit an arrival.

items.q: 这个球场太小___，十个人不能一起踢。
items.zh: 这个球场太小了，十个人不能一起踢。
items.py: zhè ge qiú chǎng tài xiǎo le shí ge rén bù néng yī qǐ tī
items.en: This pitch is too small for ten people to play together.
items.why: 'Too small' is a complete remark with 太…了. 地 and 着 are not used after an adjective at the end of a clause.

items.q: 昨天我们打___球就去吃火锅___。
items.zh: 昨天我们打了球就去吃火锅了。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ men dǎ le qiú jiù qù chī huǒ guō le
items.en: Yesterday we went for hotpot as soon as we'd finished playing ball.
items.why: A past sequence takes 了 after the first verb (打了球) and a closing 了 after the last step (吃火锅了). 着 would mean playing while going, and 的 and 地 are not verb endings.

items.zh: 我们已经走了一个小时了。
items.py: wǒ men yǐ jīng zǒu le yī ge xiǎo shí le
items.en: We've already been walking for an hour.
items.why: 已经 goes with the double-了 pattern: 了 right after 走 and again at the end. 已经 stays before the verb phrase.

items.zh: 我不想去健身房了。
items.py: wǒ bù xiǎng qù jiàn shēn fáng le
items.en: I don't want to go to the gym any more.
items.why: 'Not any more' is 不 + verb phrase + 了, so 了 goes at the very end. 没 would only deny a past event.

items.q: 你吃___饭再去游泳，不然会不舒服。
items.zh: 你吃了饭再去游泳，不然会不舒服。
items.py: nǐ chī le fàn zài qù yóu yǒng bù rán huì bù shū fu
items.en: Eat first and then go swimming, or you'll feel unwell.
items.why: 'Do A, then B' with 再 puts 了 after the first verb, before its object. 着 would mean the eating is still in progress, so 再 could not move on to swimming.

items.zh: 昨天地铁站里人很多。
items.py: zuó tiān dì tiě zhàn lǐ rén hěn duō
items.en: The subway station was crowded yesterday.
items.why: A past description with 很 + adjective is a state, so it takes no 了; 昨天 carries the past. 昨天 may come before or after 地铁站里.

items.src_py: wǒ cháng qù nà jiā kā fēi guǎn
items.task: Say you don't go there any more.
items.zh: 我不去那家咖啡馆了。
items.py: wǒ bù qù nà jiā kā fēi guǎn le
items.en: I'm not going to that café any more.
items.why: 'Not any more' is 不 + verb + 了, with 了 at the end. 没去 would only say you did not go on one occasion. The object 那家咖啡馆 may also be fronted as a topic.

items.q: 我累了，不想跑步___。
items.zh: 我累了，不想跑步了。
items.py: wǒ lèi le bù xiǎng pǎo bù le
items.en: I'm tired, I don't want to run any more.
items.why: 'Not any more' is 不 + verb + 了, with 了 at the end. 吗 would make it a question, and 着 and 过 do not close a negative wish.

items.q: 我们吃___饭，现在去踢球吧。
items.zh: 我们吃了饭，现在去踢球吧。
items.py: wǒ men chī le fàn xiàn zài qù tī qiú ba
items.en: We've eaten, so let's go and play football now.
items.why: 'Eat, then go' puts 了 after the first verb, before its object, since the eating is done before the next step. 着 would mean eating is still going on, which clashes with 现在去踢球.

items.src_py: tā tī le yī ge xiǎo shí qiú
items.task: Say he has been playing for an hour and is still playing.
items.zh: 他踢了一个小时球了。
items.py: tā tī le yī ge xiǎo shí qiú le
items.en: He has been playing football for an hour now.
items.why: 'So far, and still going' adds a final 了 to the 了 after the verb. 球 can follow the verb phrase or be fronted before 踢了.

items.s: 小王去年在了北京。
items.zh: 小王去年在北京。
items.py: xiǎo wáng qù nián zài běi jīng
items.en: Xiao Wang was in Beijing last year.
items.why: 在 says where someone was, a state, so 在了 is not used for 'was at'. 去年 alone supplies the past.
items.s_py: xiǎo wáng qù nián zài le běi jīng

items.zh: 这个地方太吵了。
items.py: zhè ge dì fang tài chǎo le
items.en: This place is too noisy.
items.why: A 太 remark closes with 了, so 了 comes last, after the adjective. 太 sits directly before the adjective.

items.zh: 这家球鞋店的东西太贵了。
items.py: zhè jiā qiú xié diàn de dōng xi tài guì le
items.en: Things in this sports-shoe shop are too expensive.
items.why: 太贵了 is the complete remark, with 了 last. The modifier 这家球鞋店的 must stay in front of 东西.

items.s: 我昨天去了一趟超市。
items.zh: 我昨天去了一趟超市。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān qù le yī tàng chāo shì
items.en: I made a trip to the supermarket yesterday.
items.why: A finished action with a counted amount (一趟) takes 了 right after the verb, so 去了一趟 is correct. Nothing is missing, so the sentence is fine.

items.s: 他以前是游泳教练，现在去别的城市工作了。
items.zh: 他以前是游泳教练，现在去别的城市工作了。
items.py: tā yǐ qián shì yóu yǒng jiào liàn xiàn zài qù bié de chéng shì gōng zuò le
items.en: He used to be a swimming coach; now he has gone to work in another city.
items.why: 是 stays bare for the past state (以前是), while 现在…了 reports a new situation: he has moved on. Each 了 is where it belongs.

items.q: 听说他的网球越打越好，现在已经能参加比赛___。
items.zh: 听说他的网球越打越好，现在已经能参加比赛了。
items.py: tīng shuō tā de wǎng qiú yuè dǎ yuè hǎo xiàn zài yǐ jīng néng cān jiā bǐ sài le
items.en: I hear his tennis keeps getting better, and he can already enter matches now.
items.why: 已经能 reports a new ability that did not exist before, so the sentence ends in 了. 过 would mean he has joined matches before, and 着 or 的 would leave the change unmarked.

items.q: 上大学的时候，我一般每天晚上都在操场跑___半个小时步。
items.zh: 上大学的时候，我一般每天晚上都在操场跑半个小时步。
items.py: shàng dà xué de shí hou wǒ yī bān měi tiān wǎn shang dōu zài cāo chǎng pǎo bàn ge xiǎo shí bù
items.en: When I was at university I usually jogged on the sports ground for half an hour every evening.
items.why: 一般 and 每天晚上 make this a routine, so even with a duration (半个小时) there is no 了. 了 would describe one half-hour run that is over.

items.q: 我们没找到___那家书店。
items.zh: 我们没找到那家书店。
items.py: wǒ men méi zhǎo dào nà jiā shū diàn
items.en: We didn't find that bookshop.
items.why: 没 + 找到 already reports the failure; adding 了 would claim the finding happened. In a denial the verb stays bare.

items.q: 我们下___班就去爬山。
items.zh: 我们下了班就去爬山。
items.py: wǒ men xià le bān jiù qù pá shān
items.en: We'll go hiking as soon as we get off work.
items.why: 'As soon as A, then B' puts 了 right after the first verb, even for a plan. 着 and 地 do not fit 下班, and 过 is about a past experience.

items.s: 我们昨天了踢两个小时球。
items.zh: 我们昨天踢了两个小时球。
items.py: wǒ men zuó tiān tī le liǎng ge xiǎo shí qiú
items.en: We played ball for two hours yesterday.
items.why: 了 attaches directly after the verb it completes (踢了); it can never stand in front of the verb.
items.s_py: wǒ men zuó tiān le tī liǎng ge xiǎo shí qiú

items.src_py: tiān qì hěn lěng
items.task: Say it has turned cold now.
items.zh: 天气冷了。
items.py: tiān qì lěng le
items.en: It's gotten cold.
items.why: A change of state ends in 了. Dropping 很 removes the plain-description reading: 很冷 alone describes how things are, not that something changed.

items.s: 我小时候常常去了游泳池。
items.zh: 我小时候常常去游泳池。
items.py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou cháng cháng qù yóu yǒng chí
items.en: As a child I often went to the swimming pool.
items.why: 常常 marks a repeated habit, and habits take no 了 even in the past. 去了 would describe one finished trip, which clashes with 常常.
items.s_py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou cháng cháng qù le yóu yǒng chí

items.q: 他今天早上跑___五公里。
items.zh: 他今天早上跑了五公里。
items.py: tā jīn tiān zǎo shang pǎo le wǔ gōng lǐ
items.en: He ran five kilometres this morning.
items.why: A completed run with a counted distance needs 了 straight after the verb, before 五公里. 着 and 在 describe an action in progress, and 的 does not belong after a verb here.

items.src_py: xiān chī fàn zài qù kàn bǐ sài
items.task: Rewrite with 了: eat first, then go.
items.zh: 吃了饭再去看比赛。
items.py: chī le fàn zài qù kàn bǐ sài
items.en: Eat first and then go and watch the match.
items.why: 'Do A, then B' puts 了 right after the first verb (吃了饭), and 再 introduces the next step.

items.s: 我以前在上海住了三年，后来搬到了北京。
items.zh: 我以前在上海住了三年，后来搬到了北京。
items.py: wǒ yǐ qián zài shàng hǎi zhù le sān nián hòu lái bān dào le běi jīng
items.en: I used to live in Shanghai for three years and later moved to Beijing.
items.why: 以前 and 后来 make the three years a closed period, so one 了 after 住 is right; a second final 了 would say he still lives there.

items.src_py: zhè jiā diàn yǒu miàn bāo
items.task: Say there is no bread left.
items.zh: 这家店没有面包了。
items.py: zhè jiā diàn méi yǒu miàn bāo le
items.en: This shop has no bread left.
items.why: 'None left' is 没有 + noun + 了: 没有 replaces 有 and 了 closes the sentence.

items.q: 他腿受伤以后就___踢球___，现在只在旁边看。
items.zh: 他腿受伤以后就不踢球了，现在只在旁边看。
items.py: tā tuǐ shòu shāng yǐ hòu jiù bù tī qiú le xiàn zài zhǐ zài páng biān kàn
items.en: After his leg injury he stopped playing football; now he only watches from the side.
items.why: 'Stopped doing X' is 不 + verb + 了. 别 is a command, and 着 or 吗 cannot mark the change from playing to not playing.

items.zh: 他昨天下了班就去健身房了。
items.py: tā zuó tiān xià le bān jiù qù jiàn shēn fáng le
items.en: Yesterday he went to the gym right after work.
items.why: A past sequence has 了 on the first verb (下了班) and a closing 了 after the last step. 昨天 can come before or after 他.

items.q: 这家健身房的人___多___，我不想去。
items.zh: 这家健身房的人太多了，我不想去。
items.py: zhè jiā jiàn shēn fáng de rén tài duō le wǒ bù xiǎng qù
items.en: There are too many people in this gym, so I don't want to go.
items.why: 'Too many' is 太 + adjective + 了. 很, 非常 and 特别 mean 'very', do not take a closing 了, and cannot combine with these endings.

items.q: 她打___两个小时网球，累得走不动了。
items.zh: 她打了两个小时网球，累得走不动了。
items.py: tā dǎ le liǎng ge xiǎo shí wǎng qiú lèi de zǒu bù dòng le
items.en: She played tennis for two hours and was too tired to walk.
items.why: The two hours are finished and led to her being tired, so 了 follows 打. 着 would keep her playing, 过 is only 'have ever played', and 地 does not attach to a verb.

items.q: 我打___两年乒乓球___，水平还是很差。
items.zh: 我打了两年乒乓球了，水平还是很差。
items.py: wǒ dǎ le liǎng nián pīng pāng qiú le shuǐ píng hái shì hěn chà
items.en: I've been playing table tennis for two years and I'm still poor at it.
items.why: 'Two years so far, and still going' needs 了 after the verb and again at the end. 着 cannot sit before a duration, and a final 着 does not close the sentence.

items.src_py: wǒ shàng wǔ qù le qiú chǎng
items.task: Make it negative: I didn't go.
items.zh: 我上午没去球场。
items.py: wǒ shàng wǔ méi qù qiú chǎng
items.en: I didn't go to the court in the morning.
items.why: To deny a finished action use 没 before the verb and drop 了. 上午 can come before or after 我.

items.q: 这条路上的车太多___，骑自行车一点儿也不安全。
items.zh: 这条路上的车太多了，骑自行车一点儿也不安全。
items.py: zhè tiáo lù shàng de chē tài duō le qí zì xíng chē yī diǎn r yě bù ān quán
items.en: There are too many cars on this road; cycling is not safe at all.
items.why: 车太多 is a full remark, so it ends in 了. 的 would turn 太多 into a modifier and break the clause; 着 and 过 do not follow adjectives.

items.q: 那天晚上我觉得___这场球赛很精彩。
items.zh: 那天晚上我觉得这场球赛很精彩。
items.py: nà tiān wǎn shang wǒ jué de zhè chǎng qiú sài hěn jīng cǎi
items.en: That night I thought the match was very exciting.
items.why: 觉得 reports an opinion, a state, so it takes no 了 even in the past. 觉得了 does not mean 'thought'; 那天晚上 supplies the time.

items.q: 我昨天踢___两个小时足球。
items.zh: 我昨天踢了两个小时足球。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān tī le liǎng ge xiǎo shí zú qiú
items.en: I played football for two hours yesterday.
items.why: One finished event with a counted duration takes 了 right after the verb. 过 would only say it is something I have experienced, and 着 and 的 cannot mark completion.

items.q: 他现在会游蛙泳___，不用再学了。
items.zh: 他现在会游蛙泳了，不用再学了。
items.py: tā xiàn zài huì yóu wā yǒng le bù yòng zài xué le
items.en: He can swim breaststroke now, so he doesn't need to learn any more.
items.why: 现在会 marks a new ability: he could not before, he can now, so 了 ends the clause. 过 would mean he has swum breaststroke at some time; 着 and 的 mark nothing here.

items.s: 他以前是了足球运动员。
items.zh: 他以前是足球运动员。
items.py: tā yǐ qián shì zú qiú yùn dòng yuán
items.en: He used to be a football player.
items.why: 是 is not an action that can be completed, so 是了 never means 'was'. 以前 alone gives the past.
items.s_py: tā yǐ qián shì le zú qiú yùn dòng yuán

items.s: 公园里没有人了。
items.zh: 公园里没有人了。
items.py: gōng yuán lǐ méi yǒu rén le
items.en: There's no one left in the park.
items.why: 没有 + noun + 了 means 'none left'. The 了 is part of that pattern and is correct, unlike 没 + verb for a plain past denial.

items.q: 我昨天___去踢球。
items.zh: 我昨天没去踢球。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān méi qù tī qiú
items.en: I didn't go and play football yesterday.
items.why: To deny a past event use 没 + verb, with no 了. 不 is for habits, will and intention, and 别 and 不要 give orders.

items.q: 昨天公园里人很多，大家都很高兴___。
items.zh: 昨天公园里人很多，大家都很高兴。
items.py: zuó tiān gōng yuán lǐ rén hěn duō dà jiā dōu hěn gāo xìng
items.en: Yesterday the park was crowded and everyone was happy.
items.why: 很高兴 describes how people felt, a state, and 昨天 already places it in the past. 了 would suggest they had just become happy, which is not what the sentence says.

items.s: 太贵的球拍我不买。
items.zh: 太贵的球拍我不买。
items.py: tài guì de qiú pāi wǒ bù mǎi
items.en: I won't buy a racket that's too expensive.
items.why: Here 太贵 only modifies 球拍 and is not a complete remark, so it takes no 了. 太贵了 is for the standalone 'It's too expensive!'.

items.zh: 他已经会打乒乓球了。
items.py: tā yǐ jīng huì dǎ pīng pāng qiú le
items.en: He can already play table tennis.
items.why: 已经会 reports a new ability, so 了 closes the sentence. 已经 sits before 会, and 了 cannot move before the object.

items.q: 今天___冷，我们可以在外面踢球。
items.zh: 今天不太冷，我们可以在外面踢球。
items.py: jīn tiān bù tài lěng wǒ men kě yǐ zài wài miàn tī qiú
items.en: It's not very cold today, so we can play football outside.
items.why: Only 不太 fits 'so we can play outside': it means 'not very cold' and takes no 了. 太, 很 and 非常 all say it is cold, and 太冷 would also need 了.

items.q: 我儿子都五岁___，还不会游泳。
items.zh: 我儿子都五岁了，还不会游泳。
items.py: wǒ ér zi dōu wǔ suì le hái bù huì yóu yǒng
items.en: My son is already five and still can't swim.
items.why: 都…了 says 'already': he has reached a new age, and a changed age ends in 了. Without it 都五岁 is left hanging, and 过 and 的 do not mark change.

items.q: 我在路口等___十分钟，公交车才来。
items.zh: 我在路口等了十分钟，公交车才来。
items.py: wǒ zài lù kǒu děng le shí fēn zhōng gōng jiāo chē cái lái
items.en: I waited ten minutes at the junction before the bus finally came.
items.why: 等 completed a counted ten minutes, so 了 goes right after the verb. 着 means 'while waiting' and cannot take a duration; 过 would be about experience.

items.zh: 小王在地铁站等了二十分钟。
items.py: xiǎo wáng zài dì tiě zhàn děng le èr shí fēn zhōng
items.en: Xiao Wang waited twenty minutes at the subway station.
items.why: 等了 takes the counted duration straight after it. The place phrase 在地铁站 comes before the verb, never after the duration.

items.zh: 他学了三个月游泳了。
items.py: tā xué le sān ge yuè yóu yǒng le
items.en: He has been learning to swim for three months and is still at it.
items.why: 'Three months so far, still going' needs 了 after the verb and 了 at the very end. The final 了 cannot come before 游泳.

items.src_py: tā pǎo le wǔ gōng lǐ
items.task: Add 已经 and say he has run five kilometres so far.
items.zh: 他已经跑了五公里了。
items.py: tā yǐ jīng pǎo le wǔ gōng lǐ le
items.en: He has already run five kilometres.
items.why: With 已经 and an amount 'so far', 了 appears after the verb and again at the end. 已经 goes before the verb.

items.q: 他在公园里骑___一个小时自行车，出了很多汗。
items.zh: 他在公园里骑了一个小时自行车，出了很多汗。
items.py: tā zài gōng yuán lǐ qí le yī ge xiǎo shí zì xíng chē chū le hěn duō hàn
items.en: He cycled in the park for an hour and sweated a lot.
items.why: The hour is finished and had a result (sweating), so 了 follows 骑. 着 keeps the riding going, which clashes with 出了很多汗, and 的 is not a verb ending.

items.q: 昨天下午我在___体育馆，没看到他。
items.zh: 昨天下午我在体育馆，没看到他。
items.py: zuó tiān xià wǔ wǒ zài tǐ yù guǎn méi kàn dào tā
items.en: I was at the gym yesterday afternoon and didn't see him.
items.why: 在 says where someone was, a state, so 在了 is not used for 'was at'. The past comes from 昨天下午.

items.q: 小时候我常常和哥哥一起去河边钓___鱼。
items.zh: 小时候我常常和哥哥一起去河边钓鱼。
items.py: xiǎo shí hou wǒ cháng cháng hé gē ge yī qǐ qù hé biān diào yú
items.en: As a child I often went fishing by the river with my older brother.
items.why: 常常 and 小时候 describe a repeated childhood habit, so the verb takes no 了 even though it is in the past. 了 would suggest one finished trip.

items.q: 周末我们在公园打___一下午羽毛球。
items.zh: 周末我们在公园打了一下午羽毛球。
items.py: zhōu mò wǒ men zài gōng yuán dǎ le yī xià wǔ yǔ máo qiú
items.en: We played badminton in the park all afternoon at the weekend.
items.why: 打 finished a counted stretch of time (一下午), so 了 follows the verb. 着 would make it a state in progress; 的 and 地 never attach to a verb like this.

items.q: 已经八点___，比赛马上要开始了。
items.zh: 已经八点了，比赛马上要开始了。
items.py: yǐ jīng bā diǎn le bǐ sài mǎ shàng yào kāi shǐ le
items.en: It's already eight o'clock and the match is about to start.
items.why: A clock time that has just been reached is a new situation, so 了 closes 已经八点. 吗 and 吧 are for questions or suggestions and do not fit a plain report.

items.q: 你的球打得太好___！
items.zh: 你的球打得太好了！
items.py: nǐ de qiú dǎ de tài hǎo le
items.en: You play so well!
items.why: An exclamation with 太 + adjective closes with 了. 吗 would turn it into a question, and 的 would leave the remark hanging.

items.zh: 他每个周末都去游泳馆。
items.py: tā měi ge zhōu mò dōu qù yóu yǒng guǎn
items.en: He goes to the swimming pool every weekend.
items.why: 每个周末都 marks a habit, so the verb takes no 了, which is why the spare tile is unused. 每个周末 can open the sentence or follow 他.

items.q: 他们踢___一个小时___，比分还是零比零。
items.zh: 他们踢了一个小时了，比分还是零比零。
items.py: tā men tī le yī ge xiǎo shí le bǐ fēn hái shì líng bǐ líng
items.en: They've been playing for an hour and it's still nil-nil.
items.why: 还是零比零 shows the game is still going, so the hour is 'so far': 了 after 踢 and 了 at the end. Without both, the hour sounds closed off.

items.q: 我们的水喝完了，没有水___。
items.zh: 我们的水喝完了，没有水了。
items.py: wǒ men de shuǐ hē wán le méi yǒu shuǐ le
items.en: We've drunk all our water and have none left.
items.why: 'Run out' is 没有 + noun + 了, ending with 了. 着 and 的 cannot close it, and 吗 would turn it into a question.

items.s: 我女儿了八岁。
items.zh: 我女儿八岁了。
items.py: wǒ nǚ ér bā suì le
items.en: My daughter is eight now.
items.why: The change-of-state 了 ends the sentence after the age; it cannot come before the number.
items.s_py: wǒ nǚ ér le bā suì

items.s: 明天你下了班给我打个电话。
items.zh: 明天你下了班给我打个电话。
items.py: míng tiān nǐ xià le bān gěi wǒ dǎ ge diàn huà
items.en: Call me tomorrow after you get off work.
items.why: 'After A, then B' uses 了 after the first verb even for the future, because it marks A as done before B. 明天 does not forbid it.

items.zh: 我们下了课就去打球。
items.py: wǒ men xià le kè jiù qù dǎ qiú
items.en: We'll go and play ball as soon as class is over.
items.why: 下了课 gives the first step as done, and 就 starts the second. Even for a plan, 了 follows the first verb.

items.q: 球票卖完了，我们没有票___，只能在家看电视。
items.zh: 球票卖完了，我们没有票了，只能在家看电视。
items.py: qiú piào mài wán le wǒ men méi yǒu piào le zhǐ néng zài jiā kàn diàn shì
items.en: The tickets are sold out; we have none left and can only watch TV at home.
items.why: 'Have none left' is 没有 + noun + 了, with 了 at the end. 吗 would make it a question, and 着 and 的 cannot close it.

items.src_py: tā mǎi le nà zhāng qiú piào
items.task: Make it negative.
items.zh: 他没买那张球票。
items.py: tā méi mǎi nà zhāng qiú piào
items.en: He didn't buy that match ticket.
items.why: Negate with 没 and delete 了: 没买, not 没买了. A specific object (那张球票) changes nothing.

items.q: 路上堵车，所以我们没有在九点以前到___体育馆。
items.zh: 路上堵车，所以我们没有在九点以前到体育馆。
items.py: lù shang dǔ chē suǒ yǐ wǒ men méi yǒu zài jiǔ diǎn yǐ qián dào tǐ yù guǎn
items.en: There was a traffic jam, so we didn't get to the gym before nine.
items.why: 没有 denies the arrival, so 到 takes no 了. 到了 would claim the arrival happened, and 过 would say 'never been there', which is not what the sentence is about.

items.s: 这家球馆太了大。
items.zh: 这家球馆太大了。
items.py: zhè jiā qiú guǎn tài dà le
items.en: This sports hall is too big.
items.why: 了 closes the whole 太 + adjective remark; it cannot sit between 太 and the adjective.
items.s_py: zhè jiā qiú guǎn tài le dà

items.zh: 我吃了饭就去公园。
items.py: wǒ chī le fàn jiù qù gōng yuán
items.en: I'll go to the park once I've eaten.
items.why: In 'after A, then B', 了 is attached to the first verb (吃了) and 就 introduces the next step. 我 may open the sentence or follow 吃了饭.

items.q: 他去年是___我们队的教练。
items.zh: 他去年是我们队的教练。
items.py: tā qù nián shì wǒ men duì de jiào liàn
items.en: He was our team's coach last year.
items.why: 是 is a state, not an action that can be completed, so 是了 is never 'was'. 去年 alone puts it in the past.

items.q: 这条路太远___，我们坐出租车去吧。
items.zh: 这条路太远了，我们坐出租车去吧。
items.py: zhè tiáo lù tài yuǎn le wǒ men zuò chū zū chē qù ba
items.en: It's too far this way; let's take a taxi.
items.why: 'Too far' is a complete remark with 太…了, so 了 closes it. 着 and 过 cannot follow an adjective this way.

items.q: 我明天下___课就去球场找你。
items.zh: 我明天下了课就去球场找你。
items.py: wǒ míng tiān xià le kè jiù qù qiú chǎng zhǎo nǐ
items.en: I'll come and find you at the court as soon as class is over tomorrow.
items.why: Even though it is tomorrow, 'once class is over, then ...' uses 了 after the first verb. 了 marks completion before the next step, not past time.

items.s: 我不了去游泳。
items.zh: 我不去游泳了。
items.py: wǒ bù qù yóu yǒng le
items.en: I'm not going swimming any more.
items.why: 'Not any more' puts 了 at the end of the clause, after 不 + the verb phrase, not between 不 and the verb.
items.s_py: wǒ bù le qù yóu yǒng

items.zh: 他上午游了一千米。
items.py: tā shàng wǔ yóu le yī qiān mǐ
items.en: He swam a thousand metres in the morning.
items.why: 游了 keeps 了 right after the verb, before the counted distance. 上午 may come before or after 他 but stays ahead of the verb.

items.q: 我已经___喝可乐___，现在只喝水。
items.zh: 我已经不喝可乐了，现在只喝水。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng bù hē kě lè le xiàn zài zhǐ hē shuǐ
items.en: I don't drink cola any more; now I only drink water.
items.why: 已经 plus 不 + verb needs a closing 了 for 'no longer'. 别 is a command, and 着 or 吗 would not mark the change.

items.s: 我们以前经常在这个球场踢了球。
items.zh: 我们以前经常在这个球场踢球。
items.py: wǒ men yǐ qián jīng cháng zài zhè ge qiú chǎng tī qiú
items.en: We often used to play ball on this pitch.
items.why: 经常 marks a repeated habit, so 踢 takes no 了; with 了 it would be one finished event, which clashes with 经常.
items.s_py: wǒ men yǐ qián jīng cháng zài zhè ge qiú chǎng tī le qiú

items.q: 昨天比赛结束以后，教练请我们每个人吃___一碗面。
items.zh: 昨天比赛结束以后，教练请我们每个人吃了一碗面。
items.py: zuó tiān bǐ sài jié shù yǐ hòu jiào liàn qǐng wǒ men měi ge rén chī le yī wǎn miàn
items.en: After the match yesterday, the coach treated each of us to a bowl of noodles.
items.why: 吃 happened once, yesterday, with a counted object (一碗面), so 了 follows 吃. 着 describes a state while eating, which does not fit a treat that was finished.

items.q: 太晚了，我们不去夜市___，回家休息吧。
items.zh: 太晚了，我们不去夜市了，回家休息吧。
items.py: tài wǎn le wǒ men bù qù yè shì le huí jiā xiū xi ba
items.en: It's too late; we're not going to the night market after all. Let's go home and rest.
items.why: A changed plan ('not going after all') is 不 + verb + 了. 的 and 着 do not close it, and 吗 would make the clause a question.

items.s: 他昨天没去了体育馆。
items.zh: 他昨天没去体育馆。
items.py: tā zuó tiān méi qù tǐ yù guǎn
items.en: He didn't go to the gym yesterday.
items.why: 没 already denies the event, so 了 cannot be added after the verb.
items.s_py: tā zuó tiān méi qù le tǐ yù guǎn

items.q: 前面就是地铁站，我们快到___。
items.zh: 前面就是地铁站，我们快到了。
items.py: qián miàn jiù shì dì tiě zhàn wǒ men kuài dào le
items.en: The subway station is just ahead; we're almost there.
items.why: 快…了 means 'about to', a change on its way, so 了 ends the sentence. 过 and 着 cannot close 快到, and 的 leaves the phrase unfinished.

items.src_py: tā men kàn le nà chǎng bǐ sài
items.task: Make it negative.
items.zh: 他们没看那场比赛。
items.py: tā men méi kàn nà chǎng bǐ sài
items.en: They didn't watch that match.
items.why: 没 already says the watching did not happen, so 了 is removed. 没看了 would contradict itself.

items.q: 小时候他很不喜欢___运动，现在却每天都去健身房。
items.zh: 小时候他很不喜欢运动，现在却每天都去健身房。
items.py: xiǎo shí hou tā hěn bù xǐ huan yùn dòng xiàn zài què měi tiān dōu qù jiàn shēn fáng
items.en: As a child he really disliked exercise, but now he goes to the gym every day.
items.why: 喜欢 is a feeling, a state, so 了 is left out even for the past; 小时候 shows the time. 了 would read as a change that has just happened, which conflicts with the contrast.

items.q: 我们昨天走___三公里才到公园。
items.zh: 我们昨天走了三公里才到公园。
items.py: wǒ men zuó tiān zǒu le sān gōng lǐ cái dào gōng yuán
items.en: Yesterday we walked three kilometres before we reached the park.
items.why: 走 covered a counted distance and finished, so 了 comes right after the verb. 着 cannot be followed by a distance; 的 and 地 are not verb endings.

items.q: 这双球鞋太贵___，我不买。
items.zh: 这双球鞋太贵了，我不买。
items.py: zhè shuāng qiú xié tài guì le wǒ bù mǎi
items.en: These sports shoes are too expensive, so I won't buy them.
items.why: A 太 remark ends in 了: 太贵了. 的 turns it into a noun phrase, and 吗 and 吧 change it into a question or suggestion.

items.q: 从早上到现在，他一共跑___二十公里___，还想继续跑。
items.zh: 从早上到现在，他一共跑了二十公里了，还想继续跑。
items.py: cóng zǎo shang dào xiàn zài tā yī gòng pǎo le èr shí gōng lǐ le hái xiǎng jì xù pǎo
items.en: Since this morning he has run twenty kilometres in all and wants to keep running.
items.why: 到现在 and 还想继续 show the total is 'so far', not closed: 了 after 跑 and a second 了 at the end. 吗 would turn it into a question.

items.q: 他今天早上没跑___步。
items.zh: 他今天早上没跑步。
items.py: tā jīn tiān zǎo shang méi pǎo bù
items.en: He didn't go running this morning.
items.why: 没 denies the event outright, so there is nothing for 了 to mark as completed. 着 and 的 are not endings that can follow 没跑.

items.q: 本来我想骑车去，可是下大雨了，我只好不骑___，改坐地铁。
items.zh: 本来我想骑车去，可是下大雨了，我只好不骑了，改坐地铁。
items.py: běn lái wǒ xiǎng qí chē qù kě shì xià dà yǔ le wǒ zhǐ hǎo bù qí le gǎi zuò dì tiě
items.en: I originally meant to cycle, but it started pouring, so I had to give up on it and take the subway.
items.why: 'Changed my mind, not doing it' is 不 + verb + 了, with 了 at the end. 着, 过 and 的 do not mark the change of plan.

items.q: 他们经常在这家球馆打___羽毛球。
items.zh: 他们经常在这家球馆打羽毛球。
items.py: tā men jīng cháng zài zhè jiā qiú guǎn dǎ yǔ máo qiú
items.en: They often play badminton at this sports hall.
items.why: 经常 marks a habit, so no 了 after 打. 了 would turn it into a single completed game, and 着 and 的 do not fit.

items.q: 以前我们总是坐___地铁去体育馆。
items.zh: 以前我们总是坐地铁去体育馆。
items.py: yǐ qián wǒ men zǒng shì zuò dì tiě qù tǐ yù guǎn
items.en: We always used to take the subway to the gym.
items.why: 总是 marks a repeated routine in the past, which takes no 了. With 了, 坐了地铁去 would describe a single trip that has been completed.

items.q: 上周我没买___球票，所以今天不能去看比赛。
items.zh: 上周我没买球票，所以今天不能去看比赛。
items.py: shàng zhōu wǒ méi mǎi qiú piào suǒ yǐ jīn tiān bù néng qù kàn bǐ sài
items.en: I didn't buy a ticket last week, so I can't go to the match today.
items.why: 没 already says the purchase did not happen, so 了 cannot follow 买. 了 marks completion and clashes with 没.

items.q: 昨天我很忙，我___去游泳，也___去跑步。
items.zh: 昨天我很忙，我没去游泳，也没去跑步。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ hěn máng wǒ méi qù yóu yǒng yě méi qù pǎo bù
items.en: I was busy yesterday: I didn't go swimming and I didn't go running either.
items.why: Denying two past events uses 没 + verb each time, with no 了. 不 would sound like a refusal or a plan, and 别 is a command.

items.s: 比赛快要开始了。
items.zh: 比赛快要开始了。
items.py: bǐ sài kuài yào kāi shǐ le
items.en: The match is about to start.
items.why: 快要…了 frames something about to happen, and the final 了 is required, so this sentence is correct.

items.q: 我刚才在地铁站买___一张去机场的票。
items.zh: 我刚才在地铁站买了一张去机场的票。
items.py: wǒ gāng cái zài dì tiě zhàn mǎi le yī zhāng qù jī chǎng de piào
items.en: I just bought a ticket to the airport at the subway station.
items.why: 刚才 points to one finished purchase with a counted object, so 了 sits right after 买. 过 would say I have bought one at some time in my life, which does not fit 刚才.

items.zh: 他没带地图出门。
items.py: tā méi dài dì tú chū mén
items.en: He didn't take a map when he went out.
items.why: 没 negates 带 and the verb stays bare, so the spare 了 is not used. The 没带地图 part can also follow 出门.

items.q: 我爸爸常常在公园里下___棋。
items.zh: 我爸爸常常在公园里下棋。
items.py: wǒ bà ba cháng cháng zài gōng yuán lǐ xià qí
items.en: My dad often plays chess in the park.
items.why: 常常 shows a regular habit, so there is no 了 after 下. 了 would present one completed game, and 的 and 地 are not verb endings.

items.s: 我们小时候每天都在河边玩，天黑了才回家。
items.zh: 我们小时候每天都在河边玩，天黑了才回家。
items.py: wǒ men xiǎo shí hou měi tiān dōu zài hé biān wán tiān hēi le cái huí jiā
items.en: When we were kids we played by the river every day and only went home when it got dark.
items.why: 每天都 makes 玩 a habit, so it takes no 了. The 了 in 天黑了 is a separate change of state (it has got dark), so both parts are correct.

items.s: 上个周末我在家，我的哥哥也在家。
items.zh: 上个周末我在家，我的哥哥也在家。
items.py: shàng ge zhōu mò wǒ zài jiā wǒ de gē ge yě zài jiā
items.en: Last weekend I was at home, and my brother was at home too.
items.why: 在 says where someone was, a state, so it takes no 了 even in the past; 上个周末 supplies the time. Adding 了 after 在 would be wrong.

items.s: 我昨天忘了带手机，所以没给你打电话。
items.zh: 我昨天忘了带手机，所以没给你打电话。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān wàng le dài shǒu jī suǒ yǐ méi gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
items.en: I forgot to bring my phone yesterday, so I didn't call you.
items.why: 没 denies the call, so 打 stays bare with no 了. 忘了 is a separate finished event, so its 了 is right.

items.q: 昨天晚上我给朋友打___两个电话。
items.zh: 昨天晚上我给朋友打了两个电话。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ gěi péng you dǎ le liǎng ge diàn huà
items.en: Last night I made two phone calls to a friend.
items.why: One finished event with a counted object: 了 goes right after 打, before 两个. 过 would claim an experience at some point in life, which clashes with the specific time 昨天晚上.

items.q: 小王昨天下载___三个新游戏。
items.zh: 小王昨天下载了三个新游戏。
items.py: xiǎo wáng zuó tiān xià zǎi le sān ge xīn yóu xì
items.en: Xiao Wang downloaded three new games yesterday.
items.why: A single completed download of a counted number of games: 了 right after 下载. 过 means 'has ever downloaded' and 着 describes a continuing state, neither fits a specific day.

items.q: 我刚才给小李发___三条消息。
items.zh: 我刚才给小李发了三条消息。
items.py: wǒ gāng cái gěi xiǎo lǐ fā le sān tiáo xiāo xi
items.en: I just sent Xiao Li three messages.
items.why: 刚才 points to one finished act and 三条 counts the object, so 了 sits right after 发. 过 is experience over a lifetime and cannot go with 刚才.

items.q: 上个周末我和朋友看___两部电影。
items.zh: 上个周末我和朋友看了两部电影。
items.py: shàng ge zhōu mò wǒ hé péng you kàn le liǎng bù diàn yǐng
items.en: Last weekend my friend and I watched two films.
items.why: A bounded past event with a counted object takes 了 directly after 看. 着 is for a continuing posture or state, and 在 would make it an ongoing action, not a finished one.

items.q: 他昨天在手机上存___五百张照片。
items.zh: 他昨天在手机上存了五百张照片。
items.py: tā zuó tiān zài shǒu jī shàng cún le wǔ bǎi zhāng zhào piàn
items.en: Yesterday he saved five hundred photos on his phone.
items.why: One completed act (昨天) with a counted object needs 了 right after 存. 着 describes a state that lasts and cannot report a single yesterday event.

items.q: 为了买新手机，她攒___三个月的钱。
items.zh: 为了买新手机，她攒了三个月的钱。
items.py: wèi le mǎi xīn shǒu jī tā zǎn le sān ge yuè de qián
items.en: To buy a new phone, she saved money for three months.
items.why: A finished stretch of saving with a stated length takes 了 right after 攒, before 三个月. 在 would make the saving ongoing, while the English says it is done.

items.q: 昨天朋友请我吃饭，我们在饭馆里聊___整整三个小时，大家都不想走。
items.zh: 昨天朋友请我吃饭，我们在饭馆里聊了整整三个小时，大家都不想走。
items.py: zuó tiān péng you qǐng wǒ chī fàn wǒ men zài fàn guǎn lǐ liáo le zhěng zhěng sān ge xiǎo shí dà jiā dōu bù xiǎng zǒu
items.en: Yesterday a friend treated me to a meal, and we chatted in the restaurant for a full three hours; nobody wanted to leave.
items.why: A bounded stretch (整整三个小时) of one finished event: 了 right after 聊. 过 would mean a life experience, which does not fit the specific 昨天.

items.q: 他为了抢演唱会的票，在网上排___两个小时的队，最后还是没抢到。
items.zh: 他为了抢演唱会的票，在网上排了两个小时的队，最后还是没抢到。
items.py: tā wèi le qiǎng yǎn chàng huì de piào zài wǎng shàng pái le liǎng ge xiǎo shí de duì zuì hòu hái shi méi qiǎng dào
items.en: To get concert tickets he queued online for two hours and still failed in the end.
items.why: A completed wait with a stated length: 了 right after 排, before 两个小时. 着 and 的/地 cannot close off a finished stretch of time.

items.q: 我的手机没电___，你有充电器吗？
items.zh: 我的手机没电了，你有充电器吗？
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī méi diàn le nǐ yǒu chōng diàn qì ma
items.en: My phone has run out of battery. Do you have a charger?
items.why: The phone is dead now and was not before, so the sentence ends in 了. 的 or 着 would not report the change.

items.q: 你看，下雨___，我们别去公园了。
items.zh: 你看，下雨了，我们别去公园了。
items.py: nǐ kàn xià yǔ le wǒ men bié qù gōng yuán le
items.en: Look, it's raining now. Let's not go to the park.
items.why: 下雨了 reports that rain has just started, a new situation, so 了 ends the clause. 下雨着 is not a Chinese pattern and 过 means it rained at some past time.

items.q: 已经十一点___，大家快回家吧。
items.zh: 已经十一点了，大家快回家吧。
items.py: yǐ jīng shí yī diǎn le dà jiā kuài huí jiā ba
items.en: It's already eleven o'clock. Everyone, go home now.
items.why: 已经 plus a clock time marks that the time has now arrived, so the sentence ends in 了. 的, 着 and 吗 do not report that change.

items.q: 我表弟今年十八岁___，终于可以考驾照了。
items.zh: 我表弟今年十八岁了，终于可以考驾照了。
items.py: wǒ biǎo dì jīn nián shí bā suì le zhōng yú kě yǐ kǎo jià zhào le
items.en: My cousin is eighteen now and can finally take the driving test.
items.why: 终于 signals that he has just reached an age that was not true before, so the age takes 了. 的, 着 and 过 cannot follow a number of years.

items.q: 以前他不会用微信，现在他也会用___。
items.zh: 以前他不会用微信，现在他也会用了。
items.py: yǐ qián tā bù huì yòng wēi xìn xiàn zài tā yě huì yòng le
items.en: He couldn't use WeChat before, but now he can too.
items.why: 以前 不会 versus 现在 会 is a change of ability, so 会 + verb ends in 了. 过 would mean he has used it before, the opposite of the contrast.

items.q: 网速变慢___，视频一直在转圈。
items.zh: 网速变慢了，视频一直在转圈。
items.py: wǎng sù biàn màn le shì pín yī zhí zài zhuàn quān
items.en: The internet has slowed down and the video keeps buffering.
items.why: 变慢 itself says something changed, so the clause closes with 了 to report the new state. 着 and 的 cannot report a change, and 过 would be a past experience.

items.q: 地铁快要到站___，你把手机收起来，准备下车吧。
items.zh: 地铁快要到站了，你把手机收起来，准备下车吧。
items.py: dì tiě kuài yào dào zhàn le nǐ bǎ shǒu jī shōu qǐ lái zhǔn bèi xià chē ba
items.en: The subway is about to reach the station. Put your phone away and get ready to get off.
items.why: 快要 … 了 is the frame for something about to happen, a change on its way, so 了 closes it. 着 and 的 cannot complete this frame.

items.q: 我们等___十分钟了，他还没来。
items.zh: 我们等了十分钟了，他还没来。
items.py: wǒ men děng le shí fēn zhōng le tā hái méi lái
items.en: We've been waiting ten minutes and he still hasn't come.
items.why: 还没来 shows the waiting is still going on, so the amount is marked by 了 after the verb and again at the end. 过 would make the waiting an old experience.

items.q: 我玩___两个小时手机了，该休息了。
items.zh: 我玩了两个小时手机了，该休息了。
items.py: wǒ wán le liǎng ge xiǎo shí shǒu jī le gāi xiū xi le
items.en: I've been on my phone for two hours; time to take a break.
items.why: The two hours so far are counted with 了 after 玩 and again at the end, because the phoning has lasted up to now. 过 would put it in the past with no link to now.

items.q: 他已经看___三个小时视频了，眼睛都红了。
items.zh: 他已经看了三个小时视频了，眼睛都红了。
items.py: tā yǐ jīng kàn le sān ge xiǎo shí shì pín le yǎn jīng dōu hóng le
items.en: He's been watching videos for three hours already; his eyes are red.
items.why: 已经 plus an amount so far takes 了 after the verb and 了 at the end. 着 cannot be followed by a duration, and 过 would not give the up-to-now amount.

items.q: 我用这个手机用___三年了，还没坏过。
items.zh: 我用这个手机用了三年了，还没坏过。
items.py: wǒ yòng zhè ge shǒu jī yòng le sān nián le hái méi huài guò
items.en: I've been using this phone for three years and it has never broken.
items.why: The three years run up to now, so the verb takes 了 and the sentence ends in 了. 过 after the repeated verb would not combine with a final 了 for 'so far'.

items.q: 这个群里的人已经聊___一个晚上了，消息多得我看不过来。
items.zh: 这个群里的人已经聊了一个晚上了，消息多得我看不过来。
items.py: zhè ge qún lǐ de rén yǐ jīng liáo le yī ge wǎn shang le xiāo xi duō de wǒ kàn bu guò lái
items.en: The people in this group chat have been chatting all evening already; there are so many messages I can't keep up.
items.why: The pile of messages shows the chatting has gone on up to now: 了 after 聊 and 了 at the end. 过 would describe something finished long ago.

items.q: 他在这家公司干___五年了，从来没请过假。
items.zh: 他在这家公司干了五年了，从来没请过假。
items.py: tā zài zhè jiā gōng sī gàn le wǔ nián le cóng lái méi qǐng guò jià
items.en: He's worked at this company for five years and has never taken a day off.
items.why: The five years run up to the present: 干了五年了 with two 了. 着 cannot take a duration, and 过 would suggest he no longer works there.

items.q: 你到___家就给我发消息。
items.zh: 你到了家就给我发消息。
items.py: nǐ dào le jiā jiù gěi wǒ fā xiāo xi
items.en: Message me as soon as you get home.
items.why: In 'once A is done, then B', 了 follows the first verb, here 到, even though this is about the future. 着 and 的 cannot mark A as completed.

items.q: 下___课，我们就去看电影。
items.zh: 下了课，我们就去看电影。
items.py: xià le kè wǒ men jiù qù kàn diàn yǐng
items.en: As soon as class is over, we'll go and watch a film.
items.why: The first step must be completed before 就 starts the second, so 了 follows 下. 着 would mean 'while class is going on', and 的/地 are not aspect markers.

items.q: 我洗___澡再给你回电话。
items.zh: 我洗了澡再给你回电话。
items.py: wǒ xǐ le zǎo zài gěi nǐ huí diàn huà
items.en: I'll call you back after I've showered.
items.why: With 再 the second step waits until the first is done, so 了 goes after 洗. 着 or 在 would mean the showering is going on while I call.

items.q: 昨天他吃___晚饭就出门见朋友了。
items.zh: 昨天他吃了晚饭就出门见朋友了。
items.py: zuó tiān tā chī le wǎn fàn jiù chū mén jiàn péng you le
items.en: Yesterday he went out to meet friends right after dinner.
items.why: In a past 'A then straight B' chain, 了 goes right after the first verb and a final 了 closes the sentence. 着 or 在 would make eating and leaving happen together.

items.q: 等我给手机充___电，再跟你一起去打球。
items.zh: 等我给手机充了电，再跟你一起去打球。
items.py: děng wǒ gěi shǒu jī chōng le diàn zài gēn nǐ yī qǐ qù dǎ qiú
items.en: Once I've charged my phone, I'll go play ball with you.
items.why: The charging has to be finished before 再 starts the next step, so 了 goes after 充 even though it is about the future. 着 or 在 would not mean 'once finished'.

items.q: 你看___我发的链接，就告诉我你的想法。
items.zh: 你看了我发的链接，就告诉我你的想法。
items.py: nǐ kàn le wǒ fā de liàn jiē jiù gào sù wǒ nǐ de xiǎng fǎ
items.en: As soon as you've looked at the link I sent, tell me what you think.
items.why: 'After A, then B': 了 goes after 看, before its object, and 就 starts the second step. 的 and 地 are not verb aspect markers, and 在 would make it ongoing.

items.q: 他下载___那个软件，就发现手机变得特别慢。
items.zh: 他下载了那个软件，就发现手机变得特别慢。
items.py: tā xià zǎi le nà ge ruǎn jiàn jiù fā xiàn shǒu jī biàn de tè bié màn
items.en: As soon as he downloaded that app, he found his phone had become very slow.
items.why: The discovery follows the completed download, so 了 goes right after 下载. 着 or 在 would make the download ongoing, which does not match 就发现.

items.q: 我每天晚上都用手机看___新闻。
items.zh: 我每天晚上都用手机看新闻。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān wǎn shang dōu yòng shǒu jī kàn xīn wén
items.en: Every night I read the news on my phone.
items.why: 每天晚上都 makes this a routine, not one finished event, so the verb takes no 了. 看了 would turn it into a single completed act.

items.q: 以前我们常常在群里聊___天。
items.zh: 以前我们常常在群里聊天。
items.py: yǐ qián wǒ men cháng cháng zài qún lǐ liáo tiān
items.en: We used to chat in the group chat a lot.
items.why: 常常 marks a repeated habit, even in the past, so no 了. The past comes from 以前, not from 了.

items.q: 去年夏天，他总是半夜才回___家。
items.zh: 去年夏天，他总是半夜才回家。
items.py: qù nián xià tiān tā zǒng shì bàn yè cái huí jiā
items.en: Last summer he always got home only after midnight.
items.why: 总是 shows a repeated pattern. A repeated pattern takes no 了 even in the past, and 才 does not combine with 了 here.

items.q: 以前我一般先看___朋友圈，再起床。
items.zh: 以前我一般先看朋友圈，再起床。
items.py: yǐ qián wǒ yī bān xiān kàn péng you quān zài qǐ chuáng
items.en: I used to look at Moments first and only then get up.
items.why: 一般 and 以前 describe a usual routine, so even though there is a 先 … 再 sequence there is no 了. The sequence rule is for one-time events.

items.q: 我哥哥每天放学回家都要先玩___半个小时手机，妈妈怎么说都没用。
items.zh: 我哥哥每天放学回家都要先玩半个小时手机，妈妈怎么说都没用。
items.py: wǒ gē ge měi tiān fàng xué huí jiā dōu yào xiān wán bàn ge xiǎo shí shǒu jī mā ma zěn me shuō dōu méi yòng
items.en: My brother has to play on his phone for half an hour first every day after school, and nothing Mom says makes any difference.
items.why: 每天 plus 都要 makes this a daily routine, and a habit takes no 了 even though 半个小时 is a stated length. Adding 了 would turn it into one finished stretch.

items.q: 昨天我没接___他的电话。
items.zh: 昨天我没接他的电话。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ méi jiē tā de diàn huà
items.en: I didn't answer his call yesterday.
items.why: 没 already says the action did not happen, so there is nothing to mark as completed. 没接了 is wrong.

items.q: 我还没回___小李的消息。
items.zh: 我还没回小李的消息。
items.py: wǒ hái méi huí xiǎo lǐ de xiāo xi
items.en: I haven't replied to Xiao Li's message yet.
items.why: 还没 means not yet done, which is the opposite of what 了 reports. 没 + verb never takes 了.

items.q: 上个周末我们没出去___，在家玩了一天游戏。
items.zh: 上个周末我们没出去，在家玩了一天游戏。
items.py: shàng ge zhōu mò wǒ men méi chū qù zài jiā wán le yī tiān yóu xì
items.en: Last weekend we didn't go out; we played games at home all day.
items.why: The first clause is a negated event, so 没出去 with no 了. The second clause is a finished, quantified event, so it keeps 了. Do not carry 了 into the 没 clause.

items.q: 他昨天晚上没给我发___任何消息。
items.zh: 他昨天晚上没给我发任何消息。
items.py: tā zuó tiān wǎn shang méi gěi wǒ fā rèn hé xiāo xi
items.en: He didn't send me any messages last night.
items.why: With 没, no 了 follows the verb 发. 没发了任何消息 is not Chinese, because 没 denies the whole event.

items.q: 虽然朋友一直约我，但我这周末没去___聚会，因为要加班。
items.zh: 虽然朋友一直约我，但我这周末没去聚会，因为要加班。
items.py: suī rán péng you yī zhí yuē wǒ dàn wǒ zhè zhōu mò méi qù jù huì yīn wèi yào jiā bān
items.en: Although my friend kept inviting me, I didn't go to the get-together this weekend because I had to work overtime.
items.why: 没去 is the negation of a completed event, so 了 is deleted even in a longer sentence. The reason clause does not change that.

items.q: 昨天网络坏了，所以我一整天没看___视频，也没打___游戏。
items.zh: 昨天网络坏了，所以我一整天没看视频，也没打游戏。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎng luò huài le suǒ yǐ wǒ yī zhěng tiān méi kàn shì pín yě méi dǎ yóu xì
items.en: The network was down yesterday, so all day I didn't watch videos or play games.
items.why: Both verbs are negated with 没, so neither takes 了. The 了 in 网络坏了 reports the change and is a different point.

items.q: 昨天的聚会很有意思___。
items.zh: 昨天的聚会很有意思。
items.py: zuó tiān de jù huì hěn yǒu yì si
items.en: Yesterday's party was fun.
items.why: A past description with 很 + adjective is a state, not an event, and 昨天 already shows it is past. Adding 了 would suggest the party has just turned interesting.

items.q: 我小时候很喜欢___玩电子游戏。
items.zh: 我小时候很喜欢玩电子游戏。
items.py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou hěn xǐ huan wán diàn zǐ yóu xì
items.en: I really liked playing video games when I was little.
items.why: 喜欢 is a feeling, not a completed act, so it takes no 了 in the past. 小时候 gives the time frame.

items.q: 我当时觉得___那个手机太贵，就没买。
items.zh: 我当时觉得那个手机太贵，就没买。
items.py: wǒ dāng shí jué de nà ge shǒu jī tài guì jiù méi mǎi
items.en: I thought that phone was too expensive at the time, so I didn't buy it.
items.why: 觉得 reports an opinion, a state of mind, and takes no 了 or 着. The past is shown by 当时.

items.q: 昨天的聚会上有___很多人，我只认识两个。
items.zh: 昨天的聚会上有很多人，我只认识两个。
items.py: zuó tiān de jù huì shàng yǒu hěn duō rén wǒ zhǐ rèn shi liǎng ge
items.en: There were a lot of people at yesterday's party, and I only knew two.
items.why: 有 describes how things were, so there is no 了 after it. 昨天 already places it in the past.

items.q: 当时我们都觉得___这个软件特别好用，没想到后来问题那么多。
items.zh: 当时我们都觉得这个软件特别好用，没想到后来问题那么多。
items.py: dāng shí wǒ men dōu jué de zhè ge ruǎn jiàn tè bié hǎo yòng méi xiǎng dào hòu lái wèn tí nà me duō
items.en: At the time we all thought this app was very easy to use, never expecting so many problems later.
items.why: 觉得 reports an opinion held at that time and takes no 了, even in a longer sentence. The past is shown by 当时.

items.q: 你的新手机太好___！
items.zh: 你的新手机太好了！
items.py: nǐ de xīn shǒu jī tài hǎo le
items.en: Your new phone is so great!
items.why: 太 + adjective as a complete exclamation always ends in 了. Without it the remark sounds cut off.

items.q: 地铁上的人太多___，我们打车去吧。
items.zh: 地铁上的人太多了，我们打车去吧。
items.py: dì tiě shàng de rén tài duō le wǒ men dǎ chē qù ba
items.en: There are too many people on the subway; let's take a taxi.
items.why: 太多 is a complete remark about the crowd, so it ends in 了. 的 or 呢 would not give the 'too many' complaint.

items.q: 这个视频___好笑了，我看了三遍。
items.zh: 这个视频太好笑了，我看了三遍。
items.py: zhè ge shì pín tài hǎo xiào le wǒ kàn le sān biàn
items.en: This video is so funny; I've watched it three times.
items.why: The final 了 pairs only with 太: 太好笑了 is the 'so funny!' remark. 很 and 有点 do not take 了, and 不太 would contradict watching it three times.

items.q: 她发朋友圈发得太多___，我都不想点开看了。
items.zh: 她发朋友圈发得太多了，我都不想点开看了。
items.py: tā fā péng you quān fā de tài duō le wǒ dōu bù xiǎng diǎn kāi kàn le
items.en: She posts so much on Moments that I don't even want to open it any more.
items.why: 太多 is a complete complaint closing the first clause, so it takes 了. 的, 着 and 过 cannot end a 太 remark.

items.q: 我现在不玩这个游戏___。
items.zh: 我现在不玩这个游戏了。
items.py: wǒ xiàn zài bù wán zhè ge yóu xì le
items.en: I don't play this game any more.
items.why: 'Not any more' is 不 + verb + 了 with 了 at the end. Without 了 it would only be a plain 'I don't play'.

items.q: 下雨了，我们不出去玩___。
items.zh: 下雨了，我们不出去玩了。
items.py: xià yǔ le wǒ men bù chū qù wán le
items.en: It's raining, so we're not going out to play after all.
items.why: A plan changed because of the rain, so 不 … 了 at the end. 过 means a past experience and 着 or 的 cannot report a changed decision.

items.q: 我的手机里没有流量___，没法看视频。
items.zh: 我的手机里没有流量了，没法看视频。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī lǐ méi yǒu liú liàng le méi fǎ kàn shì pín
items.en: My phone has no data left, so I can't watch videos.
items.why: 没有 + noun + 了 means 'none left': the data has run out. 着, 的 and 过 cannot say that.

items.q: 她已经不在那个群里___，你别再给她发消息了。
items.zh: 她已经不在那个群里了，你别再给她发消息了。
items.py: tā yǐ jīng bù zài nà ge qún lǐ le nǐ bié zài gěi tā fā xiāo xi le
items.en: She's no longer in that group, so stop sending her messages.
items.why: 已经不 … 了 means 'no longer', so 了 closes the clause. 过 or 着 would not express a change in the situation.

items.q: 听说明天有大雨，我们就不去爬山___，改在家里聚会吧。
items.zh: 听说明天有大雨，我们就不去爬山了，改在家里聚会吧。
items.py: tīng shuō míng tiān yǒu dà yǔ wǒ men jiù bù qù pá shān le gǎi zài jiā lǐ jù huì ba
items.en: I hear it will rain heavily tomorrow, so let's not go hiking after all and have the get-together at home instead.
items.why: The plan changes because of the forecast, so 不去 … 了. 着, 的 and 过 do not express a cancelled plan.

items.zh: 我看了消息就给你打电话。
items.py: wǒ kàn le xiāo xi jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
items.en: As soon as I've read the message, I'll call you.
items.why: 了 goes right after the first verb 看, before its object, and 就 links the second step. 看消息了就 is also said, but 了 never goes after 打电话 here.

items.zh: 他昨天给我发了三张照片。
items.py: tā zuó tiān gěi wǒ fā le sān zhāng zhào piàn
items.en: He sent me three photos yesterday.
items.why: 了 attaches to 发 and comes before the counted object 三张照片. The time word 昨天 can come before or after the subject.

items.zh: 朋友们都到了。
items.py: péng you men dōu dào le
items.en: The friends have all arrived.
items.why: The friends were not here before and are now, so 了 ends the sentence. 都 must stay before the verb 到.

items.zh: 这个游戏太难了。
items.py: zhè ge yóu xì tài nán le
items.en: This game is too hard.
items.why: 太 + adjective as a complete remark ends in 了. 了 cannot come between 太 and 难.

items.zh: 我们快到朋友家了。
items.py: wǒ men kuài dào péng you jiā le
items.en: We're almost at my friend's place.
items.why: 快 … 了 frames something about to happen, so 了 closes the sentence after 朋友家. 快 must sit before the verb 到.

items.zh: 我昨天没回他的消息。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān méi huí tā de xiāo xi
items.en: I didn't reply to his message yesterday.
items.why: 没 comes directly before the verb and the sentence takes no 了. 昨天 can go before or after the subject.

items.zh: 他已经看了三个小时的手机了。
items.py: tā yǐ jīng kàn le sān ge xiǎo shí de shǒu jī le
items.en: He has already been on his phone for three hours.
items.why: The amount so far takes 了 after the verb 看 and 了 at the end, with 已经 before the verb. 了 after 手机 alone would end the time as finished.

items.zh: 你下了班就给我发消息。
items.py: nǐ xià le bān jiù gěi wǒ fā xiāo xi
items.en: Message me as soon as you get off work.
items.why: 了 follows the first verb 下, before 班, and 就 starts the follow-up. This is a future instruction and still uses 了; 下班了就 and a fronted 下了班 are also natural.

items.zh: 上个周末我们在家打了一整天游戏。
